findings.title: DEBUG is enabled
findings.message: Django DEBUG=True is unsafe in production: verbose errors leak implementation details and may expose secrets.
findings.fix_hint:
Use an environment flag and default to False in production.

DEBUG = os.environ.get("DJANGO_DEBUG", "false").lower() in ("1", "true", "yes")

findings.title: ALLOWED_HOSTS is wildcard or empty
findings.message: ALLOWED_HOSTS contains '*', which accepts any Host header and enables HTTP Host header attacks and cache poisoning.
findings.fix_hint:
List explicit hostnames (and your service domain), e.g.:

ALLOWED_HOSTS = ["api.example.com", "www.example.com"]

Derive from environment in production; never use ['*'] outside local DEBUG.

findings.title: Hardcoded secret-like assignment
findings.message: Variable 'SECRET_KEY' is assigned a long string literal; may be a committed secret.
findings.fix_hint: Load secrets from the environment or a secrets manager.
